models.base_revision_note: pinned to the newest snapshot (no revision recorded in ITER1 exp5 for the base model's HF snapshot at hand)

precision.rule: if cc >= 8.9 and vram < 19.5 GiB: fp8_w8a8_hf else bf16_hf

templates.W1: Do not use {N} for this task.
templates.W2: Your solution must not rely on {N}.
templates.W5: Write a correct solution that does not use {N}.

novelty_segment: Write a novel algorithm for this task, one you have not seen before.
association_template: What is the standard alternative to {x} for this task? Name one algorithm and answer in one sentence.
format_line: Use only the Python standard library. Return only one ```python code block containing the function solve and any helpers, with no example usage and no explanation.
plain_completion: opened ```python fence + 'def <signature>:' + docstring(description); stop at the closing fence; max 768 new tokens

crn_slot_map.pn: W1-W5 x k 0-9, fresh direction per sample
crn_slot_map.association: 20 answers per catalogue mode, max 64 tokens
crn_slot_map.batch: B = 20 rows of one (unit, prompt); pads are *_EXTRA rows, never decisive

escape_rule.share: catalogue off-default over valid attempts (invalid and disputed excluded)
escape_rule.stage1: N = 10 (k 0-1): share >= twin + 0.20 and pass >= 0.8 x twin pass -> +20 slots
escape_rule.confirmed: pooled 30 keeps excess >= 0.20 with one-sided exact binomial p < 0.05 against p0 = (k_twin + 0.5)/(n_twin + 1), and pass >= 0.8 x twin
escape_rule.E_u: confirmed/8 per alpha; E_u = mean over alpha 1, 2; MOVABLE := E_u > 0

default_rule: modal correct-only twin label if its share >= 0.6 with N >= 50, else NO_DEFAULT
unit_formula: n[l,p] = r_Q(l) x ||h_twin_clean[l,p]||, r_Q from exp23 qwen_ratio.json key r_Q (interp over (l+1)/36), plain (not outlier-excluded) variant
edit: h_S <- h_S + (alpha*n[l,p] - (h_S - h_twin_clean[l,p]).u) u at blocks 12-23, task-spec positions, prefill only (exp22 make_edits_v4 TARGET)
direction_seed_rule: seed(unit, k) = int(sha256(f'iter5|panelB|{unit}|dir|{k}').hexdigest()[:8], 16), k = 0..7; direction = PCG64(seed).standard_normal(4096) normalised; variants and their parents share the parent's seeds

gate.stage_i: references 100% by runtime AND AST; probes pass; mutants fail; oracles agree
gate.stage_ii: gold = references + 10 base-pilot + 10 instruct gate-draw programs; two blind judges (google/gemini-2.5-flash, openai/gpt-4.1-mini; tie-break deepseek/deepseek-chat) after a 5/6 control gate; PASS: references 100%, kappa(runtime, AST) >= 0.8, runtime vs adjudicated >= 0.9; one revision round

build_stratification: alternate pilot-diverse (non-modal correct share >= 0.2) and pilot-collapsed (< 0.05) units for builds after two pilots exist; every gated unit is enrolled
mid_artifact_rule: at T+3:00, if fewer than 5 units passed stage (ii), build B8 then B9

per_unit_quantities.beta_u: share of correct base programs whose label != default (catalogue + other, invalid excluded)
per_unit_quantities.r_u: most frequent correct non-default CATALOGUE label in the base repertoire (ties flagged; top-1 hit scored 1/|tie|)

rivals.R_margin: -(mean_W [log p(default opening) - max_survivor log p(survivor opening)]), opening = reference's first <= 16 body tokens after the def line, teacher-forced under the twin prompt with assistant prefix '```python\n' + def line
rivals.R_merit: -log(runtime of fastest non-default reference / runtime of default reference) on hidden tests (+ length-ratio version)
rivals.R_novel: novelty-instruction catalogue off-default share over valid attempts
rivals.K_u: number of catalogue modes passing limits

per_unit_quantities.forecasts: BASE / ASSOC / PROX over survivors + 'other'; 5% uniform mixing over survivors, 2% 'other' floor, +0.5 pseudo-counts (BASE, ASSOC); PROX = softmax(-d_j / median_j d_j)

analysis_rules.A1: rho_A1 = Spearman(beta_u, E_u) over gated new units with a default (average ranks); exact one-sided permutation p (full enumeration n <= 9, else 10,000 shuffles); bootstrap 95% CI (10,000); secondary Spearman(beta_u, PN_excess_u); share of beta < 0.05 units with E = 0 + exact CI; 2x3 table; partial Spearman controlling K_u; rivals with paired unit-bootstrap rho differences; sensitivities (attempt beta, plain beta, uncertain-class exclusion, split B2 label); shuffled-beta placebo (1,000); clustered A1 with variants. DESCRIPTIVE within this panel (pooled bar rho >= 0.6, p < 0.01 next round).
analysis_rules.A2: movable units with beta >= 0.05 and a defined push landing: top-1 hit (r_u == landing), chance 1/(K_u - 1), exact Poisson-binomial p; log score per event under BASE/ASSOC/PROX; paired differences (exact Wilcoxon if >= 5 events); 0.10-nat margin reported; JS landing vs base.
analysis_rules.within_parent: per pair delta_beta, delta_E, per-(direction, alpha) McNemar; sign agreement; Spearman.
analysis_rules.analysis_code_freeze: analysis/a1a2.py and analysis/variants.py are hash-committed before the first push sample of any unit
